scope: Separate bounded parallel validation wrapper; no task, runtime, model or calibration-budget edits.
properties: Each requested task test file and tests/test_tasks.py are invoked exactly once, with separate logs, XML and temporary directories.
Each file must return zero, produce readable XML, collect at least one test and report no failures, errors or skips.
Task, grader, external-test, wrapper, shared-test/helper, project-dependency and harness hashes are compared before and after all jobs.
Merged XML has direct testsuite children and existing validation fields are retained; task pointers update only after whole-batch success.
Failed batches retain historical records and per-file evidence without replacing prior eligibility.
compatibility_limits: File-level process isolation creates one pytest session per file; cross-file session fixtures or implicit test-order dependencies would behave differently. Existing suites use isolated workspaces, and no cross-file dependency was introduced.
The top-level command identifies this wrapper; actual uv run pytest commands are retained under file_runs. Current calibrate/freeze consumers do not constrain command shape.

Existing consumers validate aggregate log/XML hashes and task identities. They do not independently re-check the additional per-file/dependency fields after validation; those are retained and bound as evidence for review.
Temporary workspaces are cleaned after execution; each per-file log/XML and the merged evidence remain retained.
Docker contention and actual speedup remain unmeasured. Root will use the already-required rollout validation as the first real integration. No whole Docker suites were run for this wrapper.
